claims.claim: tag `ep01` 的商品寫死在程式碼裡：`MemoryProducts` 內建 3 件商品，只有 `List` 一個方法。`ep01` 還沒有 `db/migrations`，`go.mod` 也沒有 pgx。資料庫是這一章新增的。
claims.claim_en: At tag `ep01` the products are hard-coded: `MemoryProducts` holds 3 built-in products and has one method, `List`. `ep01` has no `db/migrations` and `go.mod` does not list pgx. The database is added in this chapter.

claims.claim: 第一個 migration `00001_create_products.sql` 建立 `products` 資料表，有 4 個欄位：`id`、`name`、`price_twd`、`created_at`。`price_twd` 有 `CHECK (price_twd >= 0)`，也就是價格不能小於 0。檔案有 goose 的 Up 與 Down 兩段，Down 是 `DROP TABLE products`。
claims.claim_en: The first migration, `00001_create_products.sql`, creates the `products` table with 4 columns: `id`, `name`, `price_twd`, `created_at`. `price_twd` has `CHECK (price_twd >= 0)`, so a price cannot be below 0. The file has goose Up and Down sections, and Down is `DROP TABLE products`.

checks.pattern:
CREATE TABLE products \(
    id         integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    name       text        NOT NULL,
    price_twd  integer     NOT NULL CHECK \(price_twd >= 0\),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now\(\)
\);

claims.claim: 第二個 migration `00002_seed_products.sql` 寫入 3 件商品，價格是 2490、1290、5990，和 tag `ep01` 寫死的 3 件商品價格相同。測試 `TestProducts_List_ReturnsSeededProducts` 證明：新資料庫跑完 migration 後，`List` 依 id 回傳這 3 件商品。
claims.claim_en: The second migration, `00002_seed_products.sql`, inserts 3 products priced 2490, 1290 and 5990, the same prices as the 3 hard-coded products at tag `ep01`. The test `TestProducts_List_ReturnsSeededProducts` proves that on a fresh database, after the migrations, `List` returns these 3 products ordered by id.

claims.claim: migration 檔案編進執行檔：`db/migrations.go` 用 `//go:embed migrations/*.sql`，把檔案放進 `embed.FS` 型別的 `Migrations`。`postgres.Migrate` 用 goose 的 provider 執行 `Up`，`cmd/api/main.go` 在啟動時呼叫它。
claims.claim_en: The migration files are compiled into the binary: `db/migrations.go` uses `//go:embed migrations/*.sql` to put them in `Migrations`, an `embed.FS`. `postgres.Migrate` runs `Up` through a goose provider, and `cmd/api/main.go` calls it at startup.

claims.claim: 查詢寫在 `db/queries/products.sql`，第一行註解 `-- name: ListProducts :many`。`sqlc.yaml` 讀 `db/migrations` 當資料表定義，輸出到 `internal/repository/dbgen`。`make sqlc` 用 Docker 執行 sqlc 1.31.1。產生的 `products.sql.go` 標明 `Code generated by sqlc. DO NOT EDIT.`，並且在 tag `ep02` 裡。它有 `ListProductsRow`（`ID`、`Name`、`PriceTwd` 三個欄位）和 `ListProducts(ctx)`。
claims.claim_en: The query is in `db/queries/products.sql` with the first-line comment `-- name: ListProducts :many`. `sqlc.yaml` reads `db/migrations` as the schema and writes to `internal/repository/dbgen`. `make sqlc` runs sqlc 1.31.1 in Docker. The generated `products.sql.go` is marked `Code generated by sqlc. DO NOT EDIT.` and is committed at tag `ep02`. It has `ListProductsRow` (fields `ID`, `Name`, `PriceTwd`) and `ListProducts(ctx)`.

checks.text:
-- name: ListProducts :many
SELECT id, name, price_twd
FROM products
ORDER BY id;
// Code generated by sqlc. DO NOT EDIT.

SELECT id, name, price_twd
FROM products
ORDER BY id

claims.claim: `repository.Products` 包住 sqlc 產生的 `dbgen.Queries`：`NewProducts` 收一個 `dbgen.DBTX`，`List` 呼叫 `ListProducts`，再把 `ListProductsRow` 轉成 `repository.Product`。`internal/service` 與 `internal/handler` 都沒有出現 `dbgen`。
claims.claim_en: `repository.Products` wraps the sqlc-generated `dbgen.Queries`: `NewProducts` takes a `dbgen.DBTX`, and `List` calls `ListProducts` and converts each `ListProductsRow` into a `repository.Product`. Neither `internal/service` nor `internal/handler` mentions `dbgen`.

checks.text: Product{ID: int(row.ID), Name: row.Name, PriceTWD: int(row.PriceTwd)}

claims.claim: 從 tag `ep01` 到 tag `ep02`，`internal/service` 與 `internal/handler` 的檔案完全沒有改動。`ProductStore` 介面宣告在 `service`，只有 `List` 一個方法。記憶體版 `MemoryProducts` 和資料庫版 `Products` 都有 `List`。`cmd/api/main.go` 的接線，從 `repository.NewMemoryProducts()` 換成 `repository.NewProducts(pool)`。
claims.claim_en: From tag `ep01` to tag `ep02`, the files under `internal/service` and `internal/handler` are unchanged. The `ProductStore` interface is declared in `service` and has one method, `List`. Both the in-memory `MemoryProducts` and the database-backed `Products` have `List`. The wiring in `cmd/api/main.go` changes from `repository.NewMemoryProducts()` to `repository.NewProducts(pool)`.

claims.claim: `postgres.Open` 用 `pgxpool.New` 建立連線池，馬上呼叫 `Ping`。`Ping` 失敗時，`Open` 先關閉連線池，再回傳錯誤。所以 `DATABASE_URL` 錯誤時，`Open` 在啟動階段就回傳錯誤。
claims.claim_en: `postgres.Open` creates the pool with `pgxpool.New` and calls `Ping` right away. If `Ping` fails, `Open` closes the pool and returns an error. So a wrong `DATABASE_URL` makes `Open` return an error at startup.

claims.claim: `main` 先建立 `logger`，再呼叫 `run`；`run` 回傳 `error`；`run` 回傳錯誤之後，`main` 才記錄錯誤並呼叫 `os.Exit(1)`。`cmd/api/main.go` 裡只有這 1 處 `os.Exit(1)`。連線池用 `defer pool.Close()` 關閉，所以 `run` 正常回傳時，`pool.Close()` 會執行。
claims.claim_en: `main` creates a `logger` and then calls `run`; `run` returns an `error`; only after `run` has returned an error does `main` log it and call `os.Exit(1)`. There is exactly 1 `os.Exit(1)` in `cmd/api/main.go`. The pool is closed with `defer pool.Close()`, so it runs when `run` returns normally.

claims.claim: 從 handler 到資料庫，每個會用到資料庫的函式，第一個參數都是 `ctx`：`postgres.Open`、`postgres.Migrate`、`ProductService.List`、`Products.List`、sqlc 產生的 `ListProducts`。handler 呼叫 `products.List(req.Context())`，把請求的 context 傳下去。
claims.claim_en: From the handler down to the database, every function that touches the database takes `ctx` as its first parameter: `postgres.Open`, `postgres.Migrate`, `ProductService.List`, `Products.List`, and the sqlc-generated `ListProducts`. The handler calls `products.List(req.Context())`, passing the request's context down.

claims.claim: 整合測試檔 `product_integration_test.go` 第一行是 `//go:build integration`，並用 testcontainers 啟動 `postgres:17-alpine` 容器。不加 `-tags=integration` 時，`go test ./internal/repository` 不會編進這個檔案，輸出 `no test files`。
claims.claim_en: The first line of the integration test file `product_integration_test.go` is `//go:build integration`, and it starts a `postgres:17-alpine` container with testcontainers. Without `-tags=integration`, `go test ./internal/repository` does not compile the file and prints `no test files`.

claims.claim: 測試 `TestProducts_SurviveReconnect` 證明商品存在資料庫裡：用第一個連線池跑 migration 並新增 1 件商品，關閉第一個連線池，再開第二個連線池並再跑一次 migration。第二個連線池查到 4 件商品，第 4 件是新增的 `USB-C hub`。
claims.claim_en: The test `TestProducts_SurviveReconnect` proves the products live in the database: it runs the migrations and inserts 1 product through the first pool, closes the first pool, opens a second pool and runs the migrations again. The second pool reads 4 products, and the 4th is the inserted `USB-C hub`.

checks.text: INSERT INTO products (name, price_twd) VALUES ($1, $2)", "USB-C hub", 890

claims.claim: C# 的 Entity Framework Core 先寫 C# 的模型類別和 `DbContext`，migration 從模型的變化產生。go-shop 的 migration 是直接寫的 SQL 檔。
claims.claim_en: In C#, Entity Framework Core starts from C# model classes and a `DbContext`, and migrations are generated from changes to the model. go-shop's migrations are hand-written SQL files.
